description: Savor the authentic taste of the Middle East with this delightful falafel wrap. Crispy, golden falafel patties are nestled inside warm pita bread, generously drizzled with creamy tahini sauce and fresh vegetables. This satisfying and flavorful meal is perfect for a quick lunch or a light dinner.

instructions.title: Prepare Falafel Mixture
instructions.text: Drain the soaked chickpeas thoroughly. In a food processor, combine the drained chickpeas, chopped onion, minced garlic, fresh parsley, fresh cilantro, ground cumin, ground coriander, cayenne pepper (if using), salt, and black pepper. Pulse until the mixture is coarsely ground, not smooth. Transfer to a bowl, stir in the baking soda and all-purpose flour. Cover and chill in the refrigerator for at least 15 minutes.

instructions.title: Form Falafel Patties
instructions.text: Using a falafel scoop or your hands, form the chilled mixture into small patties or balls, about 1.5 to 2 inches in diameter. Ensure they are firm enough to hold their shape during frying. Place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.

instructions.title: Fry Falafel
instructions.text: Heat vegetable oil in a deep pot or Dutch oven to 350F (175C). Carefully lower falafel patties into the hot oil in batches, making sure not to overcrowd the pot. Fry for 3-5 minutes per batch, turning occasionally, until they are golden brown and crispy on all sides. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on a plate lined with paper towels.

instructions.title: Prepare Tahini Sauce
instructions.text: While the falafel is frying, prepare the tahini sauce. In a small bowl, whisk together the tahini paste, freshly squeezed lemon juice, minced garlic, and a pinch of salt. Gradually add cold water, starting with 1/4 cup, and whisk until the sauce is smooth and creamy. Add more water, a tablespoon at a time, until it reaches your desired drizzling consistency.

instructions.title: Prepare Vegetables
instructions.text: Dice the Roma tomatoes and English cucumber into small, even pieces. Shred the lettuce. If using pickled turnips or cucumbers, slice them thinly. Arrange all the prepared vegetables in separate bowls for easy assembly.

instructions.title: Assemble Wraps and Serve
instructions.text: Warm the pita bread according to package instructions or lightly grill it. Lay a warm pita flat and spread a generous amount of tahini sauce over it. Fill the pita with 3-4 falafel patties, a handful of diced tomatoes, cucumbers, shredded lettuce, and a few slices of pickled vegetables. Drizzle with more tahini sauce if desired. Fold or roll the pita to create a wrap and serve immediately.

tips: For perfectly crispy falafel, ensure your oil is at the correct temperature (around 350F/175C). If the oil is too cool, the falafel will absorb too much oil; if too hot, it will burn outside before cooking inside.
Do not over-blend the falafel mixture; a slightly coarse texture is desirable for authentic falafel. If the mixture is too wet, add a little more flour until it holds its shape.

Serve the wraps immediately after assembly to enjoy the warmth of the falafel and pita with fresh, crisp vegetables and creamy tahini. Leftover falafel can be reheated in an oven or air fryer for best results.
